setupSteps.title: Verify account limits
setupSteps.description: Check your account entitlement and actual limits. No remaining-budget API or fixed free token allowance has been verified.

routes.name: Step 5 Preview via NVIDIA
routes.freeOnlyEnforcement: The official developer offer is free for prototyping, but endpoint/account/request controls preventing spend have not been qualified. Free-only execution must fail closed; pinning the documented URL alone is insufficient.
restrictions: Development/evaluation entitlement is not production authorization.
At most eight images per request; video and audio unsupported on this hosted route.
max_tokens includes reasoning and answer; prompt plus output must fit the context window. The schema permits up to 1,048,576, not an independent guaranteed output allocation.
Reasoning remains enabled. Do not send enable_thinking=false as a reasoning disable switch. Preserve assistant reasoning_content and tool_call_id on continuations.
Streaming uses SSE data events ending with [DONE]; reasoning, content and tool calls arrive as deltas.
The published context value is 1M tokens; actual usable context and concurrency depend on hosting configuration. Structured output and adjustable reasoning effort are not verified for this route.
The documented max_tokens validation bound of 1,048,576 is not a separately verified usable maximum output capacity; MaximumOutput remains unknown.
Own NVIDIA API key required.
Free access is intended for prototyping/development/testing/research/evaluation. Production use requires qualification under current NVIDIA terms.
No official hosted-API quota endpoint or fixed remaining allowance verified.
No account registration, key creation, trial activation or purchase is performed by lain.

providers.name: Inception Mercury
providers.summary: Direct Mercury API with a one-time new-account trial and optional paid usage.

setupSteps.Title: Open your account
setupSteps.Description: Create or sign in to your own Inception account if desired. No registration is performed by lain.

setupSteps.Title: Create an API key
setupSteps.Description: Use API Keys; no payment details are required for the documented new-account trial.

setupSteps.Title: Check the account
setupSteps.Description: Confirm actual trial balance and any expiry in Billing. Connection remains untested until credentials are supplied.

billingPlans.Name: New-account trial
billingPlans.ResetDescription: One-time grant; no recurring reset. Expiry is not stated.

providers.name: Poe
providers.summary: Official user API with shared account points across public bots and models.

credentials.label: Registered Poe OAuth client ID
credentials.help: Optional: OAuth preparation requires a registered client and an application callback.

setupSteps.title: Create your API key
setupSteps.description: Sign in and create a user API key. Store it with the official API base URL https://api.poe.com/v1.

setupSteps.title: Check paid access
setupSteps.description: Paid API models require an active subscription or add-on points. Confirm current account-specific pricing; no minimum subscription price is assumed.

setupSteps.title: Optional official OAuth
setupSteps.description: Register an application client; use authorization code, S256 PKCE and state. Host callback and secure key persistence are integration work.

setupSteps.title: Review bot publisher
setupSteps.description: Review publisher and official marking before allowing a bot to spend your account points. A model name does not establish who operates it.

billingPlans.name: Poe subscription points
billingPlans.resetDescription: Allocation and reset depend on the account plan; unavailable in the balance response.
billingPlans.notes: Subscription and add-on points share the same reported balance. Plan price and point allocation are unknown without account evidence.

billingPlans.name: Poe add-on points
billingPlans.notes: One-time purchased points; not a free trial. Balance response does not separate their amount or expiry from plan points.
